brief:
Israeli occupation forces imposed a curfew on the town of Beit Amr north of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The measure went into effect without prior announcement of its duration or stated justification.

Residents faced immediate movement restrictions across the town. Such curfews have been a recurring tactic by Israeli forces across Palestinian towns and cities in the West Bank.
title: Israeli forces impose curfew on Beit Amr north of Hebron
